newsitem.title: USA: AMP to take Q4 $195 mln charge.
newsitem.headline: AMP to take Q4 $195 mln charge.

text.p: AMP Inc said on Tuesday that its board approved taking restructuring charges of $195 million in the fourth quarter.

In a December 12, 1996 announcement, the company said it would report operating earnings of $0.43 in the fourth quarter before the charge. The company said in the announcement that it was reviewing its operations to "reduce non-value adding costs and improve productivity."
The mostly non-cash charges are being taken to rationalize certain businesses, AMP said.
An AMP spokesman said the company will make another announcement by mid-January detailing its plans on restructuring after it informs its employees.
In the December 12 announcement, AMP said it was determining what underperforming businesses should be modified, phased out or sold.
